subject: biology
title: Adaptations and Habitats
welcome_lead: Visit polar ice, hot deserts and deep oceans to see how organisms survive extreme places.
meta_desc: KS3 Biology adventure on habitats and adaptations in different environments.
final_note: You now know how animals and plants are adapted to survive their habitats.

concepts.def: Feature that helps survival in a habitat.
Blending in to hide from predators.
Long seasonal journey to find food.
Long sleep through winter to save energy.

walkthroughs.body_html: Polar bears have thick fur, blubber and white camouflage. Penguins huddle for warmth. These adaptations reduce heat loss and improve survival.
Camels store fat in humps, have long eyelashes, and can survive without water for days. Cactus plants store water and have spines instead of leaves.
Some animals migrate to find food, others hibernate to save energy in winter. Behaviour can be as important as body features.
